scope.summary: Implement intersection resolution/untangle plus collision control toggles (CG-15, MD Intersection Resolution + collision detection toggles + Deactivate scopes): a recovery pass resolving already-interpenetrating cloth (normal/flipped-normal strategies), per-pair-type collision toggles (avatar-cloth, self, proximity; triangle-vertex vs edge-edge) in SimRunParams, and Deactivate with two scopes (pattern-only vs pattern+sewing), per Section 13.4 + 13.3.
acceptance_criteria: untangle pass: detects intersecting cloth regions and resolves via normal-side reassignment or flipped-normal recovery (MD's two modes), runnable on demand and automatically after teleport-style edits; documented limits (deep multi-layer tangles may require re-drape).
SimRunParams gains per-pair-type collision toggles (avatar_cloth, self, proximity) x (triangle_vertex, edge_edge) with defaults matching current behavior; wired into the WGSL dispatch flags.
Deactivate(pattern_only) removes a panel from sim but keeps seams pulling; Deactivate(pattern_and_sewing) removes both (MD's two distinct modes); freeze (MT-336) unchanged.
NO_INTERPENETRATION validation can invoke untangle-and-retest as a suggested_fix action.
scope.risk_if_missed: Every MD user leans on Intersection Resolution to rescue tangled states; without recovery, one bad edit means restarting the drape from scratch (models especially need mechanical recovery, not restarts).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Cloth collision, contact, and repair

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Upgrade collision from particle/proxy pushout to mesh VF/EE predictive contact, coupled layers, SDF freshness, independent triangle validation, explicit untangle, and adversarial reliability matrices while retaining analytic preview colliders and the exaggerated-body test intent.

Separate initial tessellation, post-solve retopology, checkpoint-bounded topology transactions, and authorized initial-feasibility untangle; queue topology-affecting CRDT edits and require exact commit/rollback validation.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
